usedFor: Klipfolio dashboards have users, and “Add User to Group” and “Assign User to Role” keep their access current.

bestTemplate.name: “Add User to Group” in Klipfolio
bestTemplate.why: It adds a specified user to a group, so setting up a new teammate takes one step.

watchOut: “Delete User from Group” in Klipfolio removes a user from specified groups, so check the groups before it runs.
